JEETU AHUJA Investment Banking operations | OTC Derivatives Specialist 
jeetuahuja1704@gmail.com | 8208041550 | Mumbai | linkedin.com/in/jeetu-ahuja 
 
 PROFESSIONAL  SUMMARY   
Investment banking Operations Analyst with 1.8 years of experience supporting OTC Equity Derivatives and FX trade lifecycle and 
post-trade operations. Proven expertise in trade lifecycle management, trade confirmations, client affirmations, break 
resolution, exception management, and stakeholder collaboration across Front Office, Middle Office, Legal, Credit, and 
Settlements teams. Recognised twice with the eClerx Values Award for operational excellence, bringing a proven track 
record of delivering accurate, timely, and risk-controlled post-trade support. 
 PROFESSIONAL  EXPERIENCE   
eClerx Services Ltd, Analyst – Financial Markets Operations 
 
• Managed the end-to-end confirmation lifecycle for OTC Equity Swaps, Options, and FX transactions, 
processing 100–200+ trades daily while maintaining high accuracy in a fast-paced, time-sensitive 
post-trade environment.  
• Coordinated with Front Office, Middle Office, Legal, Negotiations, Credit, and Settlements teams to 
resolve trade economic and non-economic discrepancies, minimise trade breaks, and ensure timely 
confirmation of transactions.  
• Liaised with clients, counterparties, and internal stakeholders to obtain outstanding 
confirmations/affirmations, resolve trade discrepancies, and ensure timely completion of post-trade 
activities within SLA.  
• Investigated trade exceptions through root cause analysis, identifying recurring issues and 
contributing to process improvements that enhanced operational efficiency and reduced repeat 
exceptions.  
• Monitored ageing trades and maintained closure trackers, providing management with visibility into 
outstanding exceptions, trade status, escalation priorities, and pending client/counterparty actions.  
• Collaborated with global stakeholders to drive timely resolution of critical exceptions while ensuring 
adherence to internal service-level expectations.
